votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of Tuesday, November 10, 2020.
votes.description: The Board approved the minutes from its November 10, 2020 meeting. Chris Wharton was absent.

votes.motion: Ratify the determination of the Chair to meet without an anchor location.
votes.description: The Board ratified the Chair's determination to continue holding meetings remotely and without an anchor location under HB5002.
The Board approved setting public hearing dates for the RDA FY2021-22 budget resolution and the RDA Budget Amendment No. 1 for FY2020-21.

votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for strategy sessions to discuss pending or reasonably imminent litigation and for attorney-client matters privileged pursuant to Utah Code §78B-1-137, and for other lawful purposes satisfying the Utah Open and Public Meetings Act.
votes.description: The Board voted to convene a closed session under §52-4-205(1)(c) to discuss litigation strategy and attorney-client privileged matters.
